def scan(basisf,name):
    best=[]
    for w in np.linspace(0.05,3,300):
        A=np.column_stack(basisf(w))
        c=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dP_dt,rcond=None)[0]
        r=dP_dt-A@c
        best.append((round(np.mean(r**2)/np.var(dP_dt),6),round(w,3)))
    best.sort(); print(name,best[:2])
